context: large transport and supersonic-transport-relevant passenger study
primary_measurement: passenger reaction to vertical and lateral vibration
frequency_or_scope: 0.20-7.0 Hz; vertical sensitivity reported across 1-7 Hz and lateral sensitivity across 1-3 Hz
empirical_signal: response varies with frequency, axis, and combined vibration
what_it_supports: frequency- and axis-aware passenger testing is relevant
what_remains_unproven: no current universal high-speed comfort or certification threshold

primary_measurement: discomfort response to multi-frequency and multi-axis vibration
empirical_signal: equal-discomfort curves and frequency-dependent response can be measured
what_it_supports: a reproducible method for studying combined vibration discomfort
what_remains_unproven: no direct serviceability threshold for a faster passenger aircraft

context: transport-aircraft ride-quality modelling and simulator evidence
primary_measurement: relationships among motion, noise, temperature, pressure, and seating
frequency_or_scope: multi-factor transport-aircraft scope; no single universal frequency or threshold
empirical_signal: passenger comfort is multi-factor and noise/motion tradeoffs matter
what_it_supports: why passenger environment should not be reduced to acceleration alone
what_remains_unproven: no validated high-speed passenger acceptance boundary

primary_measurement: subjective response to interior noise and combined multi-axis vibration
empirical_signal: combined stimuli and cabin context alter comfort response
what_it_supports: noise and vibration should be evaluated jointly
what_remains_unproven: helicopter contours do not establish supersonic-transport limits

frequency_or_scope: cruise configuration; criterion is qualitative and context-dependent
empirical_signal: no perceptible cruise buffeting is used as guidance, with correlation to pilot assessment
what_it_supports: a certification-evidence category separate from passenger comfort
what_remains_unproven: no passenger-specific or speed-specific serviceability pass
